metadata.description: The Guardian now stays in the Tower for as long as it is played; the vendor screens were traced to one cause.
metadata.previous_state: The game returned the Guardian to orbit after a few minutes in the Tower.
metadata.current_state: The Guardian stayed in Tower North for almost two hours; the idle return now follows the game's normal 15-minute rule.
metadata.remaining_issue: Vendor menus do not open yet: the Tower runs under the story-mission menus, and its own activity needs a permission the character does not have.
metadata.next_task: Serve the permission for the Tower's own activity so its menus and vendors load.
metadata.audio: game audio only, one emulator port; music may be present
